06.09.26

CPHI trade show: what
experienced exhibitors
understand that Pharma
brands often miss

Written by David Atkinson, Exhibits Account Director at
StillCraft Events Co.
 
I’ve attended CPHI Trade Show for many years, and one
thing I’ve noticed is how much the exhibition continues
to evolve. Every year, exhibitors place greater
importance on the look and feel of their stands, while
visitors expect more than a simple product showcase.
 
The brands that leave a lasting impression aren’t
necessarily the ones with the biggest spaces. They’re
the ones that create environments people want to spend
time in. In an industry built on trust, quality and
long-term relationships, standing out requires much
more than visibility alone.

05.03.26

StillCraft Events Co. London hub:
bringing precision, proximity
and expertise to global brands

You are planning to take your events across Europe.
Or maybe you are already doing it.
Which means you are coordinating agencies in different
countries. Managing multiple suppliers. Aligning
timelines across time zones. Defending budgets
internally. Trying to keep one concept consistent from
Nairobi to Berlin to Paris.
 
That is the reality that many of our clients are facing. And
that is the context in which the StillCraft Events Co. London hub
was created. A solution to the complexity you are
navigating. A practical move to be closer to the clients
and teams shaping European growth.
 
We sat down with Chris, our new Commercial Director
based in London, for a conversation on what this move
means for our business but most importantly, for our
clients.
Find the full interview here.

10.09.25

Do you need an international
event agency, a local partner,
or both?

International event agencies are built to orchestrate
complex, multi country programs; local partners are
masters of streets, permits and real time nuance. The
smartest event leaders do not pick a camp, they pick the
right engine for the job, and often blend both. Use this
decision guide to choose confidently and keep quality
high across borders.
